pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Out-of-tree DDC/CI driver (ddcci + ddcci-backlight). Not in ::gentoo and not in the mainline kernel; packaged here because the image profiles ship a /etc/modules-load.d entry for it and the hardened images want external monitor brightness under Plasma's own backlight control rather than through a setuid-ish userspace path.
Pinned to a master commit rather than the v0.4.5 tag: upstream has cut no release since 2024-07 and the tag does not build on kernels newer than 6.10.
